title: indias downstream gas regulator approves lpg pipeline infrastructure worth 731 2026 08 21
text:
Aug 21 (Reuters) - India's downstream petroleum and gas regulator said on Friday it has approved the ​laying of about 1,800 km of ‌LPG pipeline infrastructure at an estimated investment of 70 billion rupees ($731.49 million).
The Petroleum and Natural Gas ​Regulatory Board said the pipelines will pass ​through six states: Telangana, Maharashtra, Uttar ⁠Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Karnataka and Goa.
($1 = 95.6950 Indian rupees)
